title: SF3232 (2021-2022 Regular): Visitor carrying firearms on state university campuses modification

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2022-02-16; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/92/2022/0/SF/3232/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Version read: as-filed (introduced) text; no passage vote recorded. The bill strikes only the old paragraph letter '(c)' and the word 'and' in the renumbered paragraph (d); everything else quoted is kept or added text.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 18): (c) A public postsecondary institution regulated under chapter 136F or 137 may establish policies that restrict the carry or possession of firearms by visitors while on the institution's property.
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 18): A person carrying a firearm in violation of the public postsecondary institution policies may be ordered to leave the premises. A person who fails to leave when so requested is guilty of a petty misdemeanor. The fine for a first offense must not exceed $25. Notwithstanding section 609.531, a firearm carried in violation of this subdivision is not subject to forfeiture.
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 18): (d) Notwithstanding paragraphs (a), (b), and (c), an employer or a postsecondary institution may not prohibit the lawful carry or possession of firearms in a parking facility or parking area.
